home.title: Your personal AI study assistant
home.subtitle: This is your personalized study area. Get precise summaries, tips for study materials, generate practice quizzes on any topic, and track your learning progress to ace your exams with confidence.

chat.summaryInitial: Hi, I am Bob, Smart Study's study assistant. Send me a topic and I will summarize it. After the summary, you can ask me questions about it.
chat.quizzInitial: Hi, I am Bob, Smart Study's study assistant. I will build an 8-question quiz with several question types (multiple choice, fill in the blank, open answer, practical and real case) and grade each answer right away. Your progress is only saved if you answer them all, and the quiz adapts to what you miss the most. Which topic would you like to test? Send me the subject.

story.title: Our Story
story.text: This project was conceived and developed by Information Systems student Carolina Lansoni Vilas Boas, who was mentored by the professor Rafael Hauckewitz Todaro, in partnership with the Instituto Mauá de Tecnologia and the global Grand Challenges Scholarship Program.
